packageRules.description: One grouped PR per repo per week holds every routine update, so a maintainer admin-merges once instead of reviewing each bump.
A major can break consumers, so it waits for explicit approval on the Dependency Dashboard instead of riding the weekly group.

First-party packages are pinned on purpose as wire-compatibility readers or fixtures; other machinery owns these versions and a Renovate bump would silently undo a compat gate. This must stay the last rule so nothing above can re-enable them.
